metadata.source_note: The current official Wyoming Constitution requires any tax imposed on income to allow a full credit for sales, use, and ad valorem taxes paid by the same taxpayer to any Wyoming taxing authority in the taxable year. This higher-authority boundary does not itself impose an income tax or prove that every downstream credit and signed net-liability output is zero. It is preserved as the constitutional check on the current official sources that affirmatively state that Wyoming has no individual or state income tax.
metadata.title: Wyoming Constitution Article 15, Section 18
